title: Divisions of the Levites

questions.question: When David was old and full of days, whom did he make king?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:1 (ESV): "...he made Solomon his son king over Israel."

questions.question: At what age were the Levites numbered?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:3 (ESV): "The Levites, thirty years old and upward, were numbered..."

questions.question: How many were set apart to supervise the work of the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:4 (ESV): "Twenty-four thousand of these... to have charge of the work..."

questions.question: How many were gatekeepers and praisers?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:5 (ESV): "4,000 were gatekeepers, and 4,000 praised the LORD..."

questions.question: Who were the heads of the Gershonites?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:7 (ESV): "The sons of Gershon: Ladan and Shimei."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Kohath?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:12 (ESV): "The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four."

questions.question: Why was Aaron set apart?
options: To consecrate the most holy things and burn incense before the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: To consecrate the most holy things and burn incense before the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:13 (ESV): "...Aaron was set apart to consecrate the most holy things... to burn incense before the LORD... to minister to him and to pronounce a blessing..."

questions.question: How were the sons of Moses named?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:14 (ESV): "...the sons of Moses the man of God were named among the tribe of Levi."

questions.question: Which age requirement for Levite service was changed by David?
options: From thirty to twenty years old
questions.correctAnswer: From thirty to twenty years old
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:27 (ESV): "For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered from twenty years old and upward."

questions.question: Who had no sons but only daughters?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:22 (ESV): "Eleazar died having no sons, but only daughters..."

questions.question: Who married the daughters of Eleazar?
options: Their kinsmen, the sons of Kish
questions.correctAnswer: Their kinsmen, the sons of Kish
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:22 (ESV): "...their kinsmen, the sons of Kish, married them."

questions.question: What was the duty of the Levites regarding the undefined quantity of flour?
options: For the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil, etc.
questions.correctAnswer: For the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil, etc.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:29 (ESV): "...for the choice flour for the grain offering... for the baked offering..."

questions.question: When were they to stand and praise the LORD?
options: Every morning and likewise at evening
questions.correctAnswer: Every morning and likewise at evening
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:30 (ESV): "And they were to stand every morning... and likewise at evening,"

questions.question: Why did David say they no longer needed to carry the tabernacle?
options: Because the LORD has given rest to his people and dwells in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD has given rest to his people and dwells in Jerusalem
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 23:25-26 (ESV): "...and so the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle..."

key_verse_text: And they were to stand every morning, thanking and praising the LORD, and likewise at evening.
